query: Which preregistration, code-release, and privacy-preserving data-sharing practices (containerization, synthetic data, access tiers) will maximize reproducibility while safeguarding participant privacy?

response.query: Which preregistration, code-release, and privacy-preserving data-sharing practices (containerization, synthetic data, access tiers) will maximize reproducibility while safeguarding participant privacy?
response.answer: Preregistration, code release, and containerization maximize reproducibility. Synthetic data and restricted access tiers safeguard privacy. Combining these practices ensures both integrity and confidentiality.
